segment_ids.description: A N-D tensor containing segment indices for each element in `data`. data.shape[:len(segment_ids.shape)] should match.

num_segments.description: An integer representing the total number of segments. If not specified, it is inferred from the maximum value in `segment_ids`.

sorted.description: A boolean indicating whether `segment_ids` is sorted. Defaults to `False`.

output.description: A tensor containing the max of segments, where each element represents the max of the corresponding segment in `data`.
